description: Loopback-only HTTP listener. Frames requests and hands them to the background page; it has no mail access of its own.

functions.name: start
functions.description: Starts listening on 127.0.0.1 on a random free port. Idempotent. Resolves to {port}.

functions.name: stop
functions.description: Stops listening and removes the connection file.

functions.name: publishConnection
functions.description: Writes {port, token} to the fixed per-user connection file (dir 0700, file 0600). Resolves to {path}.

events.name: onRequest
events.description: Fired for every fully framed request. The listener must return (or resolve to) {status: integer, body: string}.

body.description: Raw body as a binary string (one char per byte).
